g.text: Theorem andb_commutative : forall b c, andb b c = andb c b.Proof. intros b c. destruct b eqn:Eb. - destruct c eqn:Ec. + reflexivity. (* true, true *) + reflexivity. (* true, false *) - destruct c eqn:Ec. + reflexivity. (* false, true *) + reflexivity. (* false, false *)Qed.
Each branch checks one row of the full two-input truth table.The outer - bullets handle b; the inner + bullets handle c.Finish one goal before moving to the next bullet.
